items.body: Oskar, does the register also need the sub-outsourcing chain for the card processor?
Erik, the appropriateness procedure for structured products now names the new test; the evidence is attached.
The reporting fields are mapped. The open questions are listed in the assessment, and the operations team is briefed next week.
Oskar, can you confirm whether the new reporting fields change what we send for securities lending? Axel, for your awareness.

items.title: No documented research budget per strategy
items.description: The new rules allow joint payment for research and execution only with a documented budget and a yearly quality assessment. Neither exists yet.

items.title: Currency exchange cost is missing from the ex ante view
items.description: The ex ante cost view for foreign shares leaves out the currency exchange cost the client pays on every order.

items.title: The warning can be dismissed with one tap and the choice is not logged
items.description: ESMA expects warnings to be prominent and the client's choice to be recorded. Today the order flow lets the client tap past the warning, and nothing is stored.
items.remediation: Add a confirmation step to the order flow and store the client's choice with the order.

items.title: Corrections after the filing date are sent by hand
items.description: A corrected control statement after the filing date is keyed in by hand, and the corrections are not logged.

text.text: The institution's own resources means funds that have not been separately invoiced to the client for the research.

Investment research from a third party may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in these regulations.

versions.transitionalNote: The annual assessment is first due for research received after 1 October 2026.

text.text: Investment research from a third party may be received only if it is paid from the institution's own resources, from a research payment account, or jointly with execution under the conditions set out in these regulations. The institution shall assess annually the quality and value of the research it receives.

items.label: Proposal
items.usageNote: A draft rule or final report proposed for adoption. Dates are proposed, not decided.

items.label: Adopted
items.usageNote: Decided by the legislator or authority, application still ahead. The prototype's 'Adopted rule', 'EU legislation' and 'EU regulation' land here until they apply.

items.label: Supervision
items.usageNote: Surveys, thematic reviews, supervisory statements. No new rule.

items.label: Enforcement
items.usageNote: A decision against a named firm. Structured facts live in enforcement_decision.

items.label: Recurring date
items.usageNote: A date the law repeats every year, such as a rate fixing or a reporting deadline.

items.label: Consultation
items.usageNote: A draft open for comments with a closing date. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: In force
items.usageNote: The rule applies from the date given. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Guidance
items.usageNote: Guidelines, Q&As, circulars and position papers from an authority. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Court ruling
items.usageNote: A judgment that settles how a rule reads. No prototype row uses it; the evaluation set does.

items.label: Not assessed
items.usageNote: No assessment recorded yet.

items.label: Compliant
items.usageNote: We meet the obligation and can show it.

items.label: Partly compliant
items.usageNote: Met in part; the status note says what is missing.

items.label: Gap
items.usageNote: Not met. A gap record with an owner and a date is expected.

items.label: Open
items.usageNote: Found and not yet being fixed.

items.label: Remediating
items.usageNote: Someone is closing it to a plan and a date.

items.label: Risk accepted
items.usageNote: Left open on purpose, with a reason and a person who decided.

items.label: Closed
items.usageNote: Fixed, and the fix is shown.

items.label: Low
items.usageNote: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

items.label: Medium
items.usageNote: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

items.label: High
items.usageNote: Tenant scale, mapped to a fixed ordinal.

items.label: Compliance
items.usageNote: The compliance function. Relabel it and add the organisation's own teams beside it.

items.label: Follow up
items.usageNote: A marker for records someone must come back to. Relabel it; it is the list's default.

items.label: Act now
items.usageNote: Something must change within weeks.

items.label: Within 3 months
items.usageNote: Work must start this quarter.

items.label: 6+ months
items.usageNote: Plan it, no rush.

items.label: Monitor
items.usageNote: Nothing to do yet, watch for the next step.

items.label: No action
items.usageNote: Noted, nothing changes for us.
